description: Canonical mid-game loadout: playerLevel 8 + gearTier 3 proxy + imbueLevel 2 proxy + 3 companions at layer 3. Single axis: dangerLevel. DESIGN INTENT (creative pass #7): a player who has earned the mid-game stack IS supposed to dominate the overworld monster curve; 'hard' is reserved for end-game bosses and for content that exceeds the player's zone band (neither of which this sim represents — single monster cell, no boss flag). Post-rebalance + pass-7 tunes, the full stack sweeps d0-d10 in 1-3 rounds. Treat this playbook as a regression detector ('mid-game stack suddenly can't clear a mid-danger mob') rather than a balance target ('mid-game stack should struggle at mid-danger').
